The “DIGNIDAD” Act is even worse than you think. If this bill became law it would destroy the country. It would be the most disastrous piece of legislation in decades. Every Republican who supports it should be run out of town. 

open.spotify.com/episode/0Xl…

The idea that we should go full resistance and basically hand the country over to the Democrats on purpose is totally retarded. The idea that any conservative who ever criticizes Trump is "panicking" and suffering from "Trump derangement syndrome" is nearly as retarded. Unfortunately these two forms of retardation have consumed vast swaths of the right wing commentariat.

Some big names have shifted full anti-Trump. Others are full pro-Trump and insist that he can never be criticized and anyone who questions him or expresses any skepticism about anything he does is a traitor to the cause. Fewer and fewer prominent figures on the right are staking out the only actual sane position, which is that Trump is a politician who sometimes we will agree with and sometimes we will not agree with, and our right and responsibility as Americans is to be honest in either case.
